name: Flying Courier
detailed_description:
Flying Courier is a simulation game about a day of experience in a courier airship. Player will complete the task of deliveries, enjoy the view from different landscapes, and help people from the world with their requests.

We started with the ideation of 'sharing something important with someone' as the theme of 'generosity'.

While the game gives the option to players, we do not want to grant actual item 'rewards' to players which breaks the core of generosity. Instead, we decided to build a vast world that players can explore more places around the world by 'being generous' and help the locals all around the world.

Therefore, we decided to build a world with different lands where players can explore and enjoy the scenery through an airship. Since the quests are simple, we decided to make the timeline of the story happen in the Victorian era with a cartoon-ish art style. Enjoy driving the courier in this lovely world!
